# Mohsin Qureshi — AI Platform Engineer & Forward-Deployed AI Engineer

> Mohsin Qureshi is an AI Platform Engineer and Forward-Deployed AI Engineer (FDE). Available for remote US/UK roles and fixed-scope production AI engagements. Specializes in production LLM, RAG, voice AI, and agentic systems moving from prototype to reliable operation. Track record includes Flipkart, Accenture, Novartis, and Ericsson.

## Core Specializations & Architecture Pillars

- **High-Concurrency Model Routing**: Two-tier routing architecture isolating lightweight deterministic SLM classifiers (<33ms p99) from frontier LLMs, delivering 72% reduction in cloud inference costs under high concurrency (Flipkart scale).
- **Production RAG & Evaluation**: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (BM25 lexical + dense vector embeddings) with cross-encoder reranking, synthetic regression evaluation suites, and verifiable citation bounding (<0.5% hallucination drift at Novartis & Accenture).
- **LLMOps & CI/CD Release Gates**: Automated eval gates for prompt/model regressions, Pydantic schema guardrails, Redis caching, and latency SLA verification before deployment.
- **Voice AI & CRM Integration**: Low-latency conversational boundaries, state handoffs, and customer escalation protocols.
- **ML Platform & Data Engineering**: Feature & embedding pipeline versioning, Kafka streaming anomaly detection (50k eps at Ericsson), and PyTorch model serving with vLLM on AWS EKS & GCP GKE.

## Production Benchmarks & Quantitative Disclosures

- Fast-Path P99 Latency: < 33ms (Edge Classifier / SLM)
- Hallucination Drift: < 0.5% (RRF + Cross-Encoder + Citation Attributions)
- Concurrency Throughput: 1.2M+ daily query capacity
- Inference FinOps Reduction: -72% (Deterministic Fast-Path Gateway)

- [Grounded RAG Explorer](https://mohsingitdev.github.io/mohsingitdev.io/#interactive-demos): Interactive visualization of hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and citation bounding box verification.
